sections.text: § 2676. Judgment as bar. The judgment in an action under section 1346(b) of this title shall constitute a complete bar to any action by the claimant, by reason of the same subject matter, against the employee of the government whose act or omission gave rise to the claim. (June 25, 1948, ch. 646, 62 Stat. 984 .)
